fraudAck.intro: For your safety, everything happens IN the app — never outside it.
fraudAck.rule1: NEVER agree when a driver, courier or merchant asks you to cancel your order or ride.

fraudAck.support: Outside Coligo: no protection, no refund, no recourse. In doubt? Contact support from the Help Center.
fraudAck.confirm: Yes, I understand and I agree
